visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing sunglasses and a denim vest, sits at a restaurant table. She shakes a menu with a yellow and black cover featuring a picture of meat. A man in a pink checkered shirt and another in a black t-shirt sit opposite her. The setting is a brightly lit indoor restaurant with wooden textured walls and wave-patterned decor. (2) Close-up on the man in the pink shirt, who has a shocked expression. The scene cuts back to the woman who is now covering her mouth and pretending to cry. (3) The man in the black shirt holds a white plastic container and looks confused. A smartphone is produced showing a funny image of a Ninja Turtle with realistic human teeth. Both men react with exaggerated expressions of shock and horror. (4) The scene transitions to a food montage showing raw cuts of beef on plates, a grill with sizzling meat, a stone pot of rice, and a buffet station with various vegetables and side dishes. A close-up shows a soft-serve ice cream machine dispensing vanilla swirls into a wafer cup. (5) Back at the table, the group is now cheering and clinking beer glasses. The woman has removed her sunglasses and is happily applying lipstick. The man in the pink shirt looks at a bill or wallet and exhibits a comical look of financial distress as the others laugh.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main creator, 2 male friends acting in the skit.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The woman wears a blue denim halter vest and sunglasses. One man wears a pink and white checkered shirt with a white t-shirt underneath; the other wears a black t-shirt with a cartoon logo.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior of 'Power of Meat' BBQ restaurant featuring modern industrial design with wooden accents, built-in tabletop grills, a self-service buffet bar, and ice cream machines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice introduces the restaurant location over a fast-paced electronic BGM. (2) A sudden percussive 'thud' sound occurs as the man reacts. The woman begins a stylized, high-pitched sobbing vocalization. (3) A cartoon 'boing' and a dramatic orchestral stinger play when the funny image is revealed. (4) Vocal narration shifts to a rhythmic, rapid-fire male voice listing food items, accompanied by a sizzling sound and metallic clicking of tongs. (5) Sound of glasses clinking followed by collective cheering. The scene ends with casual conversational speech, laughter, and a final comic digital 'ping' sound as the bill is presented.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Skit -> Feature Showcase -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the new 'Meat Power' (肉次方) restaurant branch at Kaohsiung Dream Mall by combining a humorous short-form comedy skit with a high-energy highlight reel of the food and dining environment.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of restaurant brand, mention of location, and detailed showcase of menu items and service features.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a popular social media comedy format to keep viewers engaged before transitioning into a standard promotional food vlog. The contrast between the fake heartbreak and the enjoyment of the BBQ is used as a comedic hook.
